meta.title: Database Design
meta.tagline: Structure data properly — the foundation of every data-driven application.
meta.description: Database design covers the principles of structuring data storage — from conceptual modeling to physical implementation. Includes ER modeling, normalization, indexing strategy and schema optimization.
